description: LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) adapters — small trainable rank-decomposition matrices that specialize a frozen base model for a task without full fine-tuning. A registry of adapter SPECS (shape + intent + when-to-use), not weights; pointers, never truth. Composes with ml_model_registry (the base models), models_as_memory (adapters used as a memory store), and chain_of_thought_contracts (adapters that enforce a reasoning structure). Records are synthetic/public metadata only.

adapters.name: Code-completion adapter
adapters.task: fill-in-the-middle + next-token code completion in a target stack
adapters.when_to_use: narrow per-repo or per-stack completion where a frozen base under-performs on house idioms
adapters.merge_strategy: hot-swap at inference; never merged into the base (keeps the base reusable)

adapters.name: Text-to-SQL adapter
adapters.task: natural-language to dialect-correct SQL over a known schema
adapters.when_to_use: deterministic-leaning structured-output task; pairs with a SQL validator gate downstream
adapters.merge_strategy: hot-swap; routed by the inference gateway per request

adapters.name: Tool / function-calling adapter
adapters.task: emit well-formed tool-call JSON against a tool schema
adapters.when_to_use: a base that drifts on strict tool schemas; cheaper than a larger base for the same reliability

adapters.name: Domain adapter (governed vertical)
adapters.task: domain register + terminology for a governed vertical (public corpora only)
adapters.when_to_use: domain language gap; output still passes the governance/verification rail (adapter never asserts truth)
adapters.merge_strategy: hot-swap; per-tenant adapter never becomes a global default

adapters.name: Stepwise-reasoning adapter
adapters.task: show-the-work math / multi-step reasoning with explicit intermediate steps
adapters.when_to_use: enforce a visible chain of thought; pairs with chain_of_thought_contracts as the model-side enforcer

adapters.name: Style / persona adapter
adapters.task: consistent voice/format for a brand or persona
adapters.when_to_use: cheap surface-style control without touching task competence
